metrics.registration_method: All bounded integer cells, bilinear subpixels, 9 deterministic coordinate starts per cell
metrics.comparison: Unit-flux gauge, Gaussian common beam, translation only over complete zero-extended support. No post-shift flux rescaling, cropped-error masking, rotation, Jy calibration or astrometry.

correlation.vdif_validation_scope: File origin and length, decoded range headers and nominal continuity; skipped prefix not structurally scanned
correlation.fft_accumulation: Sums of cross-products, power and fourth moments; flags after whole integration
correlation.clock_model: Supplied linear ADC mapping; no automatic weak-source clock recovery
correlation.geometry: Sample alignment and RF rephasing; piecewise linear delay over <=1s per segment, <=3s total, <=600m
correlation.weight_note: 2*valid FFT blocks / product of measured station channel powers; weak-source quadrature approximation; filtered FFT correlations not fully modeled

rate_acquisition.limits: Rates outside temporal Nyquist may alias undetectably; search range is not a measured initial LO bound. Short-cell SK may be ineligible. Noise search false-positive probability is not calibrated.

scope: WSL headless Chromium; Windows browser/WSLg desktop not directly observed
